input: Knit a chunky blanket for the nursery

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Blanket dimensions determine how much yarn is needed and how long the project will take — a lap-size throw is very different from a full crib blanket.
Knowing who the blanket is for (a specific baby, a gift, personal use) affects design choices, safety considerations, and how personalised it needs to be.
A hard deadline (e.g. a baby shower date) dictates urgency, pacing, and whether the knitter has time to learn new techniques or must stick to simple ones.
The knitter's skill level determines which stitch patterns and needle types are appropriate — a beginner needs a simpler plan than an experienced knitter.
Whether they already have yarn and needles, or need to shop, is the most immediate next action — it changes the first concrete step entirely.
Colour palette and aesthetic (neutral, bold, specific theme) must align with the nursery decor and any recipient preferences before yarn is purchased.
Whether the blanket just needs to look good or also meet safety/washability standards (e.g. machine-washable yarn for a newborn) changes material selection significantly.

gold.taskTitle: Knit a chunky blanket for the nursery
gold.taskDescription: Plan and complete a handmade chunky knit blanket intended for a nursery setting.

questions.title: What finished size should the blanket be?
questions.description: Determine the target dimensions — e.g. pram size (~75x90cm), crib size (~90x120cm), or a larger throw — to calculate yarn quantity and project scope.

questions.title: Who is the blanket being made for?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is a gift for a specific baby, a general nursery decoration, or for personal use, as this affects personalisation and design decisions.

questions.title: Is there a deadline this needs to be finished by?
questions.description: Identify any hard date such as a baby shower, due date, or gifting occasion, which will set the pace and complexity of the plan.

questions.title: How experienced are you with knitting?
questions.description: Assess skill level — complete beginner, confident with basics, or experienced — to recommend appropriate stitch patterns and needle techniques.

questions.title: Do you already have yarn and needles, or need to shop?
questions.description: Determine whether materials are on hand or need to be sourced, since this is the most immediate next action in the project.

questions.title: What colours or aesthetic should the blanket match?
questions.description: Gather colour palette preferences and nursery style (e.g. neutral tones, pastels, a specific theme) to guide yarn selection before purchasing.

questions.title: Does the yarn need to be machine-washable or hypoallergenic?
questions.description: Establish any care or safety requirements — especially important for newborn use — to narrow down suitable yarn fibre types.
